The source identity and schedule are for a 4-hour course (60 total hours), but the credit-hours cell says two hours; change that cell to 4.
The site/code and 30-hour teaching total require 2 hours, but the credit-hours cell says four hours; change that cell to 2.
The source PDF contains a selectable-text copy on pages 1-7 followed by a scanned duplicate on pages 8-14; publish only pages 1-7.
One 16-page container holds two specifications: pages 1-9 Judicial System in the Kingdom and pages 10-16 Practical Training.
